description: Store texts that a verifier must accept or reject. Mismatch kinds: modified (line not canonical or not valid, or hash does not match content), missing (absent sequence numbers or absent anchored head), chain_break (prev_hash mismatch, or sequence number repeats or goes backwards). Findings are listed once per (seq, kind), sorted by seq, then modified < missing < chain_break. Truncation of the tail is detected only with an anchor.
